npcs.name: Nell Riverwick
npcs.description: Street Sweep associated with dawn streets with a rush broom.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a street sweep and someone will point you to Nell at dawn streets with a rush broom. At 24, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Nell listens more than she sweeps, and is rarely without pocket full of lost buttons she means to return. Friend to Finn; informant to Merrick. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to save for a room that doesn't leak. What keeps them careful is being noticed by the wrong people for noticing too much. To a DM, Nell is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Mapped which cellar grates glow after midnight for Merrick.
